text:
Alex: Heads up — I'm creating RC from main. CI green, integration tests passed. Planning to request a release slot for tomorrow 10:00 UTC. Tag: v2.14.0-rc1.
Maria: nice. any DB migrations?
Alex: No schema migrations in this change, just model-serving config and a small telemetry flag.
Jen: Release notes draft is in the docs repo under `releases/2.14.0.md` — can someone eyeball for product wording?
Maria: I'll review the notes. QA ran the smoke suite on the RC build (artifact sha: 9f3a2b). Found one flaky test in conversational-routing — investigating but it looks infra-y.
Leo: SRE note: are we going to warm KV caches? RC will be promoted to prod where traffic will be routed via smart-router. If we go straight to full traffic, warmup may spike latency. Recommend staged routing + KV warm.
Alex: Agreed. Plan: promote to a small cohort (5%) for 30m, KV warm, then 25% for 15m, then full. If any P0, rollback.
Jen: Ops windows — engineering change window is 09:00-12:00 UTC tomorrow. We should request slot 09:30-11:00 to allow rollback buffer.
DeployBot: @channel Received promote request: tag=v2.14.0-rc1, env=prod-candidate, strategy=staged. To confirm run: `/deploy promote v2.14.0-rc1 --env prod --staged --schedule 2024-05-18T09:30:00Z`
Alex: I'm requesting the slot now. @Sheriff can you ack oncall availability for the window?
Sheriff: I can cover 09:15-11:30 UTC. I'll act as sheriff for the promote.
Maria: QA estimates: regression run + smoke on candidate in prod-candidate takes ~25m. We'll start immediately after the promote from staging to candidate.
Alex: One more ask — pin the model bundle to the tagged quantized artifact `bundle-q2.14-9f3a2b`. We don't want autoswitching to latest.
Leo: +1 on pin. Also request autoscaling throttle lowered during the cohort to avoid over-scaling noise. I'll apply a temporary scaling policy.
Jen: Release notes checklist: features, rollbacks, known issues, data retention note. I added a Known Issue entry about a 1-in-1000 rerank regression; QA will verify.
Alex: OK I will run the deploy command once the slot is confirmed.
DeployBot: Slot assignment complete. Deployment slot reserved: 2024-05-18T09:30:00Z - 2024-05-18T11:00:00Z. Reservation ID: slot-1840-az3.
Alex: Running promote now. Command: ```/deploy promote v2.14.0-rc1 --env prod --staged --cohorts 5,25,100 --wait 30m```
DeployBot: Starting staged promotion: cohort 5% -> 25% -> 100%. Artifact: v2.14.0-rc1 (sha: 9f3a2b). Pin applied: bundle-q2.14-9f3a2b.
DeployBot: Cohort 5% deployed. Observability links: https://console.redwood/telemetry/rollouts/slot-1840-az3
Maria: QA smoke pass on 5%. No new 5xxs, latency within SLO.
Leo: KV warm in progress, background warms showing >90% hit rate after initial 4 minutes.
Alex: Promote to 25% now.
DeployBot: Cohort 25% deployed.
Maria: QA running regression gate on 25% — will post result in 15m.
Sheriff: Monitoring dashboards look stable. No elevated error budget burn.
Maria: Regression gate cleared. No change in rerank metrics beyond expected variance.
Alex: Proceed to 100%.
DeployBot: Promoting to 100%... completed. All backends report healthy.
Leo: Autoscaling throttle still lowered — I'll restore normal policy in 10m after verifying steady state.
Jen: Great. I've updated release notes with the final artifact and rollout time. Link: https://docs.redwood/release-notes/2.14.0
Alex: Marking RC promoted to prod. Tag v2.14.0-rc1 -> prod.
DeployBot: Production promotion recorded. Release record: v2.14.0-rc1 promoted at 2024-05-18T10:12:34Z. Change window: slot-1840-az3.
Alex: Rolling the changelog and sending out the release email now.
Maria: One follow-up — that flaky conversational-routing test needs a ticket. I'll open JIRA and link to the release notes.
Sheriff: No rollback needed. If anything post-promote, raise in #incidents immediately and escalate to me.
Alex: Thanks all. :tada:
Jen: Nice work team. :shipit:
